rubric.hard_gate: A frozen or superseded dataset is capped at 45 points regardless of other factors.

datasets.name: 311 Cases
datasets.one_row_is: one service request reported to 311 since 1 July 2008

datasets.name: 311 Cases within the last day
datasets.one_row_is: one 311 case opened in the last 24 hours
caveats: Rolling 24-hour window only — there is no history here, so pair it with the full 311 Cases table

datasets.name: Top 311 Cases By Category
datasets.one_row_is: a 311 request category with its case count
caveats: Pre-aggregated — no individual cases and no coordinates

datasets.name: Bike and Scooter 311 Complaints
datasets.one_row_is: one 311 complaint about a bike or scooter

datasets.name: Police Department Incident Reports: 2018 to Present
datasets.one_row_is: one police incident report filed since 2018
caveats: Locations are snapped to the nearest intersection for anonymity — never treat a point as an exact address

datasets.name: Police Department Incident Reports: Historical 2003 to May 2018
datasets.one_row_is: one police incident report from 2003 to May 2018
caveats: Superseded by the 2018-to-present dataset
The legacy CABLE mainframe feed was shut off in May 2018, so nothing new arrives

datasets.name: Police Department Investigated Hate Crimes
datasets.one_row_is: one hate crime SFPD investigated and reported to the state
caveats: Investigated cases only — this undercounts incidents that were reported but not opened as investigations

datasets.name: Police Department Reported Victim and Suspect Demographic Data
datasets.one_row_is: an aggregated count of victims or suspects by demographic group
caveats: Aggregated counts only — cannot be linked back to individual incident reports

datasets.name: Reference: Police Department Incident Code Crosswalk
datasets.one_row_is: one incident code and what it actually means
caveats: A lookup table, not a dataset in itself — you need it to make the incident codes readable

datasets.name: Traffic Crashes Resulting in Injury
datasets.one_row_is: one traffic crash in SF that injured someone
caveats: TransBase, the old front end for this data, has been retired — tutorials and links pointing there no longer work

datasets.name: Traffic Crashes Resulting in Fatality
datasets.one_row_is: one traffic crash in SF that killed someone
caveats: Only 370 rows — far too few for prediction or modelling, though strong for a map or a memorial

datasets.name: Traffic Crashes Resulting in Injury: Parties Involved
datasets.one_row_is: one party (driver, cyclist, pedestrian) in a crash
caveats: Party-level table — useless on its own, you must join it to the main crash table on the case id

datasets.name: Traffic Crashes Resulting in Injury: Victims Involved
datasets.one_row_is: one injured person in a crash
caveats: Victim-level table — must be joined to the main crash table on the case id

datasets.name: Traffic Crashes Resulting in Injury & 2024 High Injury Network
datasets.one_row_is: an injury crash, tagged against the streets that carry most of SF's serious injuries
caveats: Bundles a specific year's High Injury Network — check which year before you quote it

datasets.name: Fire Incidents
datasets.one_row_is: one non-medical incident the fire department responded to
caveats: Federal reporting requirements changed on 1 Jan 2026, so fields before and after that date do not line up

datasets.name: Fire Department and Emergency Medical Services Dispatched Calls for Service
datasets.one_row_is: one fire or ambulance unit dispatched to a 911 call
caveats: 7.5 million rows — you must filter and paginate server-side; a naive pull will time out

datasets.name: San Francisco Police Department Drone Flight Logs
datasets.one_row_is: one police drone flight and why it was flown
caveats: The reason-for-flight field switched from free text to radio codes on 1 Sep 2025, so values before and after are not comparable

datasets.name: Building Permits
datasets.one_row_is: one building permit application and its status
caveats: Since 10 Dec 2024 this dataset only publishes NEW rows — existing permits are no longer updated in place, so status fields on older rows go stale

datasets.name: Building Permits filed on or after January 1, 2013
datasets.one_row_is: a building permit filed from 2013 onward
caveats: A filtered view of Building Permits — it inherits the same new-rows-only limitation

datasets.name: Building Permits Deduplicated on Primary Address
datasets.one_row_is: one address, with a single representative permit
caveats: One row per address — you lose every additional permit at sites that have several

datasets.name: Building Permits Contacts
datasets.one_row_is: one named contact attached to a permit
caveats: Contact table only — join to Building Permits on the permit number to be useful

datasets.name: Building Permits with Contractor, Subcontractor, Architect, Designer, or Engineer
datasets.one_row_is: a permit already joined to the professionals working on it
caveats: Pre-joined convenience view — wider and slower to query than the base permits table

datasets.name: PermitSF Permitting Data
datasets.one_row_is: one permit application in the newer PermitSF system
caveats: Overlaps the older Building Permits dataset — confirm which system covers the date range you care about before you combine them

datasets.name: Housing Production - 2005-present
datasets.one_row_is: a project that completed or partly completed new housing units

datasets.name: Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development Affordable Housing Pipeline
datasets.one_row_is: one affordable housing project in the city's pipeline
caveats: A point-in-time snapshot, not a live status feed — the project list lags reality

datasets.name: San Francisco Development Pipeline
datasets.one_row_is: one development project moving through planning
caveats: Quarter-end snapshot, so expect to be up to a quarter behind

datasets.name: Soft-Story Properties
datasets.one_row_is: one building in the mandatory seismic retrofit programme, with its compliance status
caveats: Covers only buildings enrolled in the Mandatory Soft Story Program, not every vulnerable building in SF

datasets.name: Eviction Notices
datasets.one_row_is: one eviction notice filed with the Rent Board
caveats: Notices filed, not evictions carried out — many never end in a tenant leaving
A data problem before Feb 2024 produced duplicate and incorrect rows, so treat the early years carefully

datasets.name: Count of Eviction Notices By Analysis Neighborhood and Year
datasets.one_row_is: a neighborhood-year with its eviction notice count
caveats: Already aggregated by neighborhood and year — convenient for a chart, useless for mapping individual filings

datasets.name: Petitions to the Rent Board
datasets.one_row_is: one petition a tenant or landlord filed with the Rent Board

datasets.name: Buyout Agreements
datasets.one_row_is: one declared or agreed tenant buyout

datasets.name: Requests for Information Regarding Protected Status Related to Owner Move-In Evictions
datasets.one_row_is: one request about a tenant's protected status in an owner move-in eviction

datasets.name: Rent Board Housing Inventory
datasets.one_row_is: one rental unit as reported by its owner
caveats: Self-reported by owners under the 2022 reporting law, so coverage is uneven
A data problem was corrected in Mar 2026 — earlier snapshots may disagree with today's

datasets.name: Green_Roofs
datasets.one_row_is: one green roof installation
caveats: Last refreshed April 2024
The underscored name is a sign of a raw GIS export with little curation

datasets.name: Registered Business Locations - San Francisco
datasets.one_row_is: one business location registered for city tax
caveats: Tax registration records, not a verified list of open storefronts — plenty of rows are holding companies or long-closed shops
The schema changed on 6 Jul 2026

datasets.name: Active Business Locations
datasets.one_row_is: one business location with no recorded end date
caveats: A filtered view of Registered Business Locations — same registration-not-reality caveat applies

datasets.name: Business Location Closures - Rolling 5-Year Window
datasets.one_row_is: a period with its count of business closures
caveats: Rolling five-year window only — there is no deeper history in this view

datasets.name: Mobile Food Facility Permit
datasets.one_row_is: one permitted food truck or cart location
caveats: Permitted locations, not live truck positions — a truck with a permit may not be parked there today

datasets.name: Mobile Food Schedule
datasets.one_row_is: one day-and-time slot a permitted food truck may operate
caveats: A child table of Mobile Food Facility Permit — join on the permit to get locations, or you have hours with no place

datasets.name: Street Vending Permits
datasets.one_row_is: one street vendor permit and where it applies

datasets.name: Sales Tax by Analysis Neighborhood
datasets.one_row_is: sales tax collected in one neighborhood for one period
caveats: Aggregated to neighborhood to protect taxpayer confidentiality — no business-level figures exist here

datasets.name: Invest in Neighborhood Areas
datasets.one_row_is: one commercial corridor targeted by the city's neighborhood investment programme
caveats: Last refreshed April 2024

datasets.name: SFMTA - Parking Citations & Fines
datasets.one_row_is: one parking ticket and the fine attached to it
caveats: 24 million rows — filter server-side and paginate, or you will hang the browser
Location is a street address string, not coordinates, so mapping means geocoding first

datasets.name: SFMTA - Enforced Temporary Tow Zones
datasets.one_row_is: one temporary no-parking zone that was actually enforced

datasets.name: Muni Stops
datasets.one_row_is: one Muni bus, rail or cable car stop

datasets.name: Muni Simple Routes
datasets.one_row_is: one Muni route drawn as a simplified line
caveats: Geometry is simplified for cartography — not precise enough for routing or distance calculations

datasets.name: MTA Bike Network Linear Features
datasets.one_row_is: one segment of SF's bikeway network

datasets.name: Slow Streets
datasets.one_row_is: one street segment in the Slow Streets programme
caveats: Last refreshed May 2025
The programme has been revised since that refresh, so the segment list may not match what is signed on the ground

datasets.name: Bicycle Parking Racks
datasets.one_row_is: one bike parking rack location
caveats: Last refreshed May 2025

datasets.name: Travel Decision Survey 2019
datasets.one_row_is: one survey response about how someone chooses to travel
caveats: The real data sits in a downloadable spreadsheet attachment, not a queryable API table
A one-off 2019 survey — never repeated, so there is no trend to build on

datasets.name: San Francisco Street Tree Inventory
datasets.one_row_is: one street tree, with species and planting date
caveats: Corrected in place on 9 Sep 2026 — re-pull rather than trusting anything you cached before then

datasets.name: [ARCHIVED] Street Tree List
datasets.one_row_is: one street tree, in the retired version of the inventory
caveats: Archived and replaced by the San Francisco Street Tree Inventory — use that instead

datasets.name: San Francisco Public Bathrooms and Water Fountains
datasets.one_row_is: one public bathroom or drinking fountain
caveats: Described as a growing list rather than a complete citywide inventory, so absence does not mean nothing is there

datasets.name: Covid-19 Pit Stops
datasets.one_row_is: one staffed Pit Stop public toilet location
caveats: Still maintained daily despite the COVID-era name — confirm it matches the current Pit Stop programme before you label it in a UI

datasets.name: Map of Fire Inspections
datasets.one_row_is: one fire safety inspection at a building

datasets.name: Parcels – Active and Retired
datasets.one_row_is: one recorded land parcel, active or retired
caveats: Includes retired parcels — filter to active ones or you will double-count properties

datasets.name: Analysis Neighborhoods
datasets.one_row_is: one of SF's 41 standard analysis neighborhoods
caveats: This is the boundary set most other SF datasets aggregate to — use it rather than inventing your own neighborhoods

datasets.name: Analysis Neighborhoods to ZIP Code Crosswalk
datasets.one_row_is: an overlap between a neighborhood and a ZIP code
caveats: Neighborhoods and ZIPs genuinely overlap, so this is a many-to-many crosswalk, not a clean mapping

datasets.name: Air Pollutant Exposure Zone
datasets.one_row_is: one zone flagged for elevated air pollutant exposure

datasets.name: HSH Shelter Waitlist
datasets.one_row_is: a snapshot figure from the shelter reservation waitlist
caveats: A waitlist snapshot, not individual records — you can chart the queue but not follow a person through it

datasets.name: Health Inspection Scores (2016-2019)
datasets.one_row_is: one restaurant health inspection between 2016 and 2019
caveats: Frozen: the LIVES publishing standard was retired in 2021, so nothing after 2019 appears here
There is no current restaurant inspection feed on the open data portal at all

datasets.name: Inspections by Supervisor District
datasets.one_row_is: an inspection count for one supervisor district
caveats: Aggregated and no longer refreshed

datasets.name: ARCHIVED: Tenderloin Tent Count
datasets.one_row_is: a daily tent count in the Tenderloin during 2020–21
caveats: Archived — covers only June 2020 to June 2021 and will never be extended

datasets.name: Beach Water Quality Monitoring
datasets.one_row_is: one bacteria sample taken at a beach

datasets.name: San Francisco Communitywide Greenhouse Gas Inventory
datasets.one_row_is: annual citywide emissions for one sector
caveats: Annual citywide totals only — there is no neighborhood or building breakdown

datasets.name: San Francisco Municipal Greenhouse Gas Inventory
datasets.one_row_is: annual emissions from one part of city government's own operations
caveats: Covers city government operations only, not the city as a whole — easy to confuse with the communitywide inventory

datasets.name: Employee Compensation
datasets.one_row_is: one city employee's pay for one year

datasets.name: Budget
datasets.one_row_is: a budgeted amount for one department and purpose

datasets.name: Supplier Contracts
datasets.one_row_is: one contract between the city and a supplier

datasets.name: Citywide Nonprofit Spending
datasets.one_row_is: city spending with one nonprofit organisation
caveats: The portal lists no category for this dataset, so browsing will never surface it — you have to know it exists

datasets.name: San Francisco City Survey Data
datasets.one_row_is: one resident's answers about city services and quality of life
caveats: Weighted survey responses with margins of error — treat it as opinion data, not a census

datasets.name: Planning Department Records - Projects
datasets.one_row_is: one project record in the planning department's system

datasets.name: Film Locations in San Francisco
datasets.one_row_is: one scene location from a film shot in SF
caveats: Latitude and longitude columns changed in Dec 2024, so older code against this table may break
Locations are written as free text and are often approximate

datasets.name: RPD Parks
datasets.one_row_is: one park or open space managed by Rec & Park
caveats: Last refreshed April 2024, though park boundaries change slowly enough that this matters less than it would elsewhere
